headline: Motilal Oswal recommends buying Metro Brands with Rs 1,075 target
summary: Motilal Oswal Financial Services issued a buy recommendation on Metro Brands Ltd, setting a target price of Rs 1,075 per share. Investors should note the upside potential if the target is reached.

headline: Metro Brands reports 12% rise in Q2 net profit to Rs 75.8 crore
hook: Steady double-digit growth for footwear retailer
summary: Metro Brands posted a 12% year-on-year increase in net profit to Rs 75.8 crore for the second quarter. Revenue from operations grew 12.1% during the same period. The steady performance reflects consistent consumer demand in the organized footwear retail segment. Retail investors tracking discretionary spending and consumer stocks can gauge sector health from these figures.
why_it_matters: Consistent earnings signal steady consumer demand in retail.

headline: Brokerage picks top retail stocks ahead of Q2 results
hook: Value retail and footwear lead Q2 outlook
summary: Elara Securities projects an 11.8% revenue growth for India's retail sector in Q2FY27. Growth is driven by value retail, footwear, and innerwear, while apparel demand softens due to a later festive season. The brokerage has recommended buying Metro Brands, Campus Activewear, and Vishal Mega Mart. Retail investors looking at consumer discretionary exposure can track these segments for quarterly performance cues.
why_it_matters: Footwear and value retail stocks face key Q2 performance tests.
winners_losers: Value retailers and footwear gain / apparel brands wait
